_help: Quiz for Launch a Token Simulator. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: Why do teams add liquidity when a token launches?
options: So people can buy and sell without huge price jumps
questions.answer: So people can buy and sell without huge price jumps
questions.explain: Thin liquidity makes the price swing wildly on small trades.

questions.question: What does an audit check?
options: The smart contract code for security problems
questions.answer: The smart contract code for security problems
questions.explain: An audit lowers the risk of bugs, but does not remove it.

questions.question: Why lock the team's tokens with vesting?
options: To show the team will not dump on buyers
To make the price go up forever
questions.answer: To show the team will not dump on buyers
questions.explain: Vesting builds trust that insiders are in it for the long run.

questions.question: What is a sign of a healthy launch week?
options: Real users using the product, not only price talk
questions.answer: Real users using the product, not only price talk
questions.explain: Use and community last longer than hype.

questions.question: Paying influencers to promise price pumps is...
options: The best way to build trust
questions.explain: Honest marketing explains the product. Promising returns misleads people.

questions.question: What should a team share openly at launch?
options: The token split, unlock dates and the audit
questions.answer: The token split, unlock dates and the audit
questions.explain: Being open about tokenomics helps buyers make informed choices.
